purpose: Substantially stronger AI after user feedback that release is easy to beat
gates: No hidden-state input to policy or search
Separate development, selection and final holdout seeds
Compare versus previous policy AND previous Legend search
Report results by player count and expert rules
Browser decision latency and model export parity
No claim of human superiority without human trials
experiments: Larger feature-v2 network with explicit forecasts, destinations and hand synergies
Broader candidate search and opponent mixtures
Search-guided policy improvement if pure self-play saturates
seed_revision: Moved selection and final holdouts above every planned training seed before either suite was used; exact collisions are checked by training/seed_audit.py.

selection_rule: Use development evidence to shortlist model/planner combinations, then independent selection suites to choose the release. Freeze hashes and settings before running all three final holdouts once; do not tune to those final results.
